recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一個邊界清楚、非小樑旁的大型淋巴聚集（lymphoid aggregate），中心細胞較淡、周邊較密，內含小血管，周圍為正常三系造血與脂肪，符合骨髓內反應性淋巴濾泡/生發中心。
features: Large, well-circumscribed lymphoid aggregate located in the intertrabecular (non-paratrabecular) space
Composed predominantly of small, round, dark lymphocytes
Slightly paler central zone with admixed red cells and small vessels, suggestive of a germinal center at low power
Surrounding marrow shows preserved trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and fat
Bony trabeculae without paratrabecular lymphoid infiltration
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows normocellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a single large, well-circumscribed intertrabecular lymphoid aggregate. The aggregate is composed mainly of small lymphocytes with a slightly paler central zone and small vessels, but a definite germinal center with centroblasts and tingible-body macrophages cannot be confirmed at this magnification. There is no paratrabecular or diffuse interstitial lymphoid infiltration. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid aggregate, possibly with germinal center formation; immunohistochemistry is helpful to confirm.

ddx.vs: FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of centrocytes that are BCL2-positive, whereas this aggregate is intertrabecular and well circumscribed.
CLL aggregates are often multiple, non-circumscribed and composed of CD5+/CD23+ small cells with proliferation centers, not a single aggregate with a germinal center.
MZL may colonize reactive germinal centers but shows light-chain restricted monocytoid/marginal zone cells and often intrasinusoidal spread.
MCL aggregates are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and lack true germinal centers.
